verdict.rationale: Whether source code or model weights are published under an open license is a fair question for an AI video-generation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents a proprietary SaaS offering (hosted platform, paid REST API, subscription tiers) and never mentions an open-source license, a public repository, or released source or weights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
